title: EUDI Wallet & eIDAS 2.0 Glossary | Who does what in the ecosystem (pt. 1)
summary: The five core EUDI Wallet roles under eIDAS 2.0 in plain language: the wallet, PID, relying party, intermediary and verifier - with legal basis.
body_markdown:
*Last updated: 4 September, 2026*


*EUDI basics, made simple. Read and understand the EUDI ecosystem in 2 minutes.*


This glossary defines the five core roles in the EUDI Wallet ecosystem under eIDAS 2.0 (Regulation (EU) 2024/1183): the wallet itself, PID, relying parties, relying party intermediaries, and verifiers.


Each entry starts with a plain-language definition and adds the practical and legal detail underneath.


Part 1 covers who reads data from the wallet;[part 2](https://authologic.com/blog/eudi-eidas-20-glossary-pt2) covers who issues credentials and guarantees trust;[part 3](https://authologic.com/blog/eudi-eidas-20-glossary-pt3) opens the wallet itself. Every term from every glossary is indexed in the[Digital Identity Glossary](https://authologic.com/blog/digital-identity-glossary-index) .
